Technical SEO.title: Google Search Internal Issues With Square Brackets in URLs
Technical SEO.summary: Google Search has been experiencing issues handling square bracket characters within URLs, with John Mueller confirming he is seeing some of the issues internally that arose with these kinds of characters in URLs.

Technical SEO.title: Google Hotel Ads Legacy Length Of Booking Bid Adjustment Doc
Technical SEO.summary: Google Ads published a new help document clarifying how length-of-stay bid adjustments differ between legacy Hotel campaigns and Search campaigns for travel, noting Hotel campaigns multiply the base bid by itinerary length while Search campaigns for travel do not.

Technical SEO.title: Google Removes AI Overviews Labels On Some AI Overviews
Technical SEO.summary: Google appears to be removing the AI Overviews label from some search results on desktop while the mobile version still displays the label, raising questions about whether this is a bug or an intentional UI change.

Technical SEO.title: Google Business Profiles Verification With Government ID
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing a new Google Business Profile verification method that requires uploading a photo of a government ID, adding to existing options such as phone, email, live video call, and mail verification.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Search Can Draw On More Pages After A Cloudflare Pilot
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Cloudflare reports that its network signals helped OpenAI index hundreds of millions of new pages for ChatGPT search, significantly expanding the content pool the AI search product can draw from.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: What Personal AI Agents Like Meta Muse And OpenAI Dots Mean For SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots access websites through connectors or cloud browsers, creating new challenges for what robots.txt controls, on-page SEO signals, and analytics can reveal about agent-driven traffic.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Search Share Fell To 12% For North American Publishers: Chartbeat
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Chartbeat data shows search's share of North American publisher pageviews dropped to 12% in Q3 2026, though the report notes a lower share percentage does not necessarily mean fewer absolute search pageviews.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Your Audience Uses AI But Does Not Trust It: Build Content For The Gap
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article outlines an SEO and content strategy aimed at audiences who regularly use AI tools but remain skeptical of them, recommending clearer sourcing, audience segmentation, and transparent product limitations.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: I Tested DeepSeek's New Search API, Here's How It Ranks And Scores Websites
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A hands-on test of DeepSeek's Search API found that its date filters excluded every undated page, accounting for 11% of results, and the piece identifies six practical checks for SEOs covering localization and log analysis.

AI Search / GEO.title: From Prompts to Priorities: A Practical AI Visibility Workflow
AI Search / GEO.summary: Moz outlines a workflow for turning AI visibility data into business priorities, covering how to evaluate LLM recommendations, track influential citations, and identify growth opportunities beyond basic prompt metrics.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google updates AI Mode and AI Overview with more links, context, carousels, and information on creators
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has updated both AI Mode and AI Overviews to surface more links, additional context, carousels, and creator attribution information within AI-generated search results.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT appears to drop UTM tracking, making AI referral traffic harder to measure
AI Search / GEO.summary: Reports indicate ChatGPT is stripping UTM parameters from outbound links, making it significantly more difficult for site owners to measure and attribute referral traffic originating from AI search.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT built its own search index
AI Search / GEO.summary: According to this post, ChatGPT has developed its own proprietary search index, a development with significant implications for how content is crawled and surfaced in AI-powered search results.

AI Search / GEO.title: A New Place To Look: Where Your Next AI Citations And Clicks Come From
AI Search / GEO.summary: The piece explores how mining customer conversations can surface useful content ideas, qualified-lead criteria, conversion feedback, and product-demand signals to inform content targeted at AI citation opportunities.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Ends Spam Update, Opens UGC: DesignRush SEO Roundup
AI Search / GEO.summary: This SEO roundup covers the conclusion of a Google spam update alongside developments around AI Overviews, user-generated content policy changes, and GPT-6 news.
